title: wg: content-09 §4.5/§4.6 use uri (tag 32) where A.1 uses tstr
description: Erratum. §4.5 url: uri (L744) and §4.6 senderClientUrl/senderUserUrl/roomUrl: uri (L807-809); CDDL uri is #6.32(tstr), so these would be tagged. §4.4 (L582), A.1 (L2788), A.2 (MsgUri = tstr, L2881) use tstr, and the changelog (L3327) says "remove tag from URLs in ExternalPart and implied headers". mimid uses tstr (decision mimid-1wgh.2.16). Fix: tstr in §4.5/§4.6.
